method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; rules in the statute's terms, exported seat questions derived from them, the reporting duty as a regulative rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Minnesota Statutes 2025, ch. 142G (retrieved 2026-10-19) and ch. 256P (retrieved 2026-10-24), with the MFIP Transitional Standard effective 1 October 2026 (51 SR 472), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mn-stat-ch-142G-2025.txt, ../../../minnesota-statutes-chapter-256p-economic-assistance-program-eligibility-and-verification/registers/source-bundle/mn-stat-ch-256P-2025.txt and ../../../minnesota-state-register-mfip-transitional-standard-2026/registers/source-bundle/; the 2026 session's amendments to 142G are not incorporated

scope: MFIP for one assistance unit in one month from 1 October 2026: the unit (142G.17, subd. 1), the property limit (256P.02, subd. 2), the 60-month limit as a count (142G.40), the initial income test (142G.16, subd. 1), the assistance payment (142G.16, subd. 2; 142G.17, subds. 5, 7) with the earned income disregard (256P.03), the HUD subsidy rule (142G.31, subd. 6) and the housing assistance grant (142G.32, subd. 1(a)), and the reporting duty (256P.07, subd. 2) as a regulative rule. Out: 142G.11 to 142G.15 in detail, employment services and sanctions, DWP, proration, hardship extensions, the cash/food split.
seat: the caregiver applying for, or receiving, MFIP
